effects.display_name: Tormentor Player-root encounter and follow-target state
effects.actual_behavior: On entry with map tormentor_health>0, DISABLE_TORMENTOR or missing DWELLERS_INCLUSION/ALL_ENTITY_INCLUSION writes health0, but does not leave the admitted arm. DWELLER_HEALTH clamps remaining health>60 to60; full_tormentor_has_previously_spawned becomes true even after disabling. Positive Player respite decrements1. failed_tormentor_find_attempts>10 resets0 and, when no Player in full-side50 at map XYZ in the CURRENT world, server attempts one native TORMENTOR MOB_SUMMONED spawn with random yaw; no later health/config/target-dimension recheck. Existing global join admission still applies. In the later independent health>0 arm, matching Player UUID clears follow target to empty when raw creativespectator, yet continues the matched arm: Primary Target delivery is recorded in its existing contract; online timer resets200 and target XYZ are written from current Player. Map health above live TORMENTOR_MAX_HEALTH is clamped (native default1024). Visual-only lightning for unloaded presence is not a damaging lightning payload. Nonmatching noncreative Player claims the follow target when target_online<=0. Separate empty-target selection and alternating target checks retain native order. entity_loaded>0 and online count>0 decreases by double(INTEGER 1/onlineCount): with at least two online Players the decrement is0. Client connection count and server current-player count are separate native reads. Later map-health>0 records current dimension, decrements recently_attacked_tormentor if positive, otherwise resets respite5; health<=0 resets recently_attacked_tormentor0. Once this later arm is admitted, its inner DISABLE_TORMENTOR health0 write also does not exit it; an earlier health0 write instead fails this later outer guard. State, defense caps and encounter admission are context, not automatic Stage candidates.

effects.display_name: Tormentor Player-root follow placement and chunk request lifecycle
effects.actual_behavior: Raw alternatechunktormentor=true is independent of current map health. Queue200 clears reload_render in the captured world without health/flag recheck. A full-side64 TORMENTOR query at map XYZ in current world resets or increments failed find attempts. Four independent live reads of F=TORMENTOR_FOLLOW_SPEED (default25, define has no range clamp) compute new X/Z=PlayerAxis+(mapAxis-PlayerAxis)*(100-F)/100 and Y=PlayerY+(mapY-PlayerY)*(100-F)/100+F*2. If distance>550 and old-position query finds a Tormentor, server NULL-source command at old map XYZ requests nearest type=arphex:tormentor,limit1 teleport to the three computed doubles. Query actor and command-selected actor are not bound together. Map XYZ are updated/synced independently even when no server command ran or the request failed; raw alternate flag clears regardless. Normal branch requires !alternate and map health>0, nonempty follow UUID equal to noncreative ticked Player, and torteletime<=0. It first requests chunk removal once and marks chunk_removal_complete=true independent of command success. When entity_loaded<=0, wrap-yaw/rotation changes only tracked presentation state. It then resets torteletime60 BEFORE searching: absence of any Tormentor in full-side600 around callback XYZ plus presence in full-side64 around map XYZ permits the same live F formula. Fresh uniformInt(1,20)==5 OR distance>400 requests the same nearest teleport and separately updates map XYZ. Otherwise absent map query sets alternate=true; if chunk_removal_complete, writes false, records current Player dimension, requests forceload add at map XYZ and resets force_unload_repeats10. The add command is bound to Player; teleport/remove commands use null actor. Positive torteletime decrements1 only in this matched normal branch. Native cleanup: health<=0 removal recipe lacks the space before run; alternate removal recipe has only two positioned coordinates. Both requests still decrement repeats independently of success. Normal removal has three coordinates and a space, but also records completion without a success result. These exact native requests do not prove chunks were loaded/unloaded. No owner/team filter or guaranteed entity transfer is added.
